items.title: Denny Zeitlin interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: I also do duets with David Grisman, the mandolin player. We did an album for his label, Acoustic Disk, that came out about a year ago.

ctx.x: And we’ll hopefully be doing some concerts around that. And then in the early spring, like maybe February or March, we’re going to do a midwest tour and that should include a week at the Jazz Showcase in Chicago. Then I’ll be going back to the Jazz Standard in May and doing some other East Coast things. Then in the summer hopefully some stuff in Europe. So that’s the touring with the trio.
